universe.label: Taiwan
universe.note: Large caps listed on the TWSE today. A basket chosen with hindsight carries survivorship bias: every name in it is one that survived and grew, so absolute returns are flattered. Comparisons between strategies on the same basket are still fair.

rules.rebalance: first session of every month; signals from every close before it, trades at its close

strategies.label: TAIEX total return
strategies.desc: The market index with dividends reinvested, no costs. The yardstick every other line is measured against.

strategies.label: Hold 0050
strategies.desc: Buy the Yuanta Taiwan 50 ETF once and hold it; dividends reinvested through the adjusted price.

strategies.label: Equal weight, monthly
strategies.desc: Every stock in the basket at equal weight, rebalanced monthly. What a rule has to beat on this basket.

strategies.label: Momentum 12-1
strategies.desc: The 5 stocks with the highest return over the past year, skipping the latest month; equal weight, monthly.

strategies.label: Reversal 1m
strategies.desc: The 5 stocks that fell most over the past month; equal weight, monthly.

strategies.label: Low volatility
strategies.desc: The 5 stocks with the calmest daily returns over the past 60 sessions; equal weight, monthly.

strategies.label: Trend 200d
strategies.desc: Each stock held only while it closes above its 200-session average, otherwise its slot sits in cash.
